# Vendored source provenance

- Android builder: https://github.com/MostafaXS1/artcraft-android @ v0.5.0
- RIFE ncnn Vulkan: https://github.com/nihui/rife-ncnn-vulkan @ a7532fc3f9f8f008cd6eecd6f2ffe2a9698e0cf7
